title: Mouses Without Borders breaks when keyboard and mouse are plugged into different devices
summary: With mouse and keyboard on different devices, MWB reportedly leaves keyboard input routed to the other machine after the cursor returns; timeline links active tracker #51077.

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirmed the symptom and explained the KVM/peripheral setup. The current MWB tracker #51077 is the coordination point; this issue alone does not establish a fix.
evidence: Steps: mouse on device A, keyboard on device B, move cursor to B then back to A; typing still goes to B.
Reporter confirmed persistence and explained the separate-device setup as a KVM bandwidth workaround.
Timeline cross-references active tracker #51077; another link #32053 concerns Voice Access and is not established as the same cause.
judgment.recommended_action: Coordinate in #51077; do not claim a fix is shipped.

fix_assessment.rationale: Active tracker coordinates the reported MWB cause area; avoid competing implementation in this issue.
